title: Titulino Language Level Assessment Question Bank
description: Schema for adaptive CEFR question banks. Each file covers one language pair (targetLanguage-from-nativeLanguage). UI instructions use nativeLanguage; all question content and options are in targetLanguage.

startBand.description: Band where the test begins for a user with no prior enrollment level. Usually A2.

bandOrder.description: Ordered list of band keys from easiest to hardest

passMark.description: Number of correct answers out of 2 needed to advance to next band

writingPrompt.description: Prompt shown to authenticated users after MCQ branching completes at this band. Null for A1/A2. Written in nativeLanguage.

questions.description: Pool of questions for this band. 2 are selected randomly per test run.

id.description: Unique stable ID: targetLang-band-NNN, e.g. en-b1-003

type.description: mcq: multiple choice with options[]. fill: single-word blank.

prompt.description: Question text. Meta-instruction in nativeLanguage; content being tested in targetLanguage.

options.description: Required for type=mcq. Answer choices in targetLanguage.

correct.description: The correct answer. Must exactly match one of options[] for mcq type.
